Schedule of Events (Corrections, additions welcome!)
Thursday, September 24, 2026 
Kick-Off Event: Our Town. Our Stories. celebration beginning the festivities.

Friday, September 25, 2026
Festival Hours: 3:00 PM – 12:00 AM (Activities & Vendors open)
Street Photography Session: 5:30 PM near the pavilion with Jennifer Maxfield (RSVP recommended)
Evening Highlights: Live music, vendor booths, Outhouse Race preview/activities, Grand Valley Beard Rally, and the Friday Night Glow Party at Circle Park.

Saturday, September 26, 2026Festival Hours: 8:30 AM – 10:00 PM
Farmers & Makers Market: 8:30 AM – 12:00 PM (moved onto Aspen Avenue to merge with the festival)
Baking & Canning Entries Due: 10:00 AM (Judging takes place following submission)

Fall Festival Parade: 10:00 AM along the main street downtown

History Fair: 11:00 AM highlighting local heritage

All-Day & Featured Activities:
10th Annual Outhouse Race
Pancake Breakfast
Pet Show & Tractor Show
Grand Valley Beard Rally

Live music performances throughout the day and evening.
